entry.title: New: BILL061(26) (Honolulu) — INTRO
entry.content:
RELATING TO REAL PROPERTY TAXATION.

Repeals the 15-year limitation on the availability of the RPT exemption for qualifying affordable rental dwelling units or housing units. Allows the RPT exemption to instead continue for as long as the affordable housing rental project is subject to an affordable housing agreement or a declaration of restrictive covenants. Makes conforming amendments.

Latest action: Introduced.

entry.title: BILL048(25) (Honolulu): MAYOR → PUBLISH
entry.content:
RELATING TO PEDESTRIAN MALLS.

Expands Fort Street Mall to include segments of South Pauahi Street and Chaplain Lane and updates various provisions related to the exceptions to the vehicular restrictions on the mall. Allows the use of a bicycle at a speed no greater than 10 miles per hour and prohibits engaging in dangerous behavior while on a bike on Fort Street, College Walk, and Sun Yat Sen Malls. Takes effect on January 1, 2027.

entry.title: BILL053(26) (Honolulu): CCL → PUBLISH
entry.content:
RELATING TO SHOPPING CARTS.

Generally prohibits possession and use of shopping carts on Oʻahu unless the shopping cart is identified by the legal owner and used on a premises under the legal control of the owner. Establishes penalties. Defines shopping cart to include metal or plastic handcarts on three or more wheels, and to exclude handcarts made out of other materials, without sides (flatbeds), or with a carrying capacity of less than 1 .41 cubic feet or 40 liters (baskets with wheels).

Status: CCL → PUBLISH

Latest action: Public hearing notice published in the Honolulu Star-Advertiser.
